is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates the efficacy of ITNs against Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions previous genotyping of kdr mutations (page 3) but does not report new genotype data for any of the specified markers in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide any genotype counts or frequencies for the study population.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Covè, Benin (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial study.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in the commune of Covè, Zou Department, Benin (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers trials performed in 2021, 2022, and 2023 (page 6).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is a new experimental hut trial, although it is part of a larger durability monitoring study (page 5).

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the bioefficacy of new and field-aged next-generation ITNs (PermaNet 3.0, Royal Guard, Interceptor G2) compared to a pyrethroid-only net (Interceptor) in experimental huts in Covè, Benin. While the paper discusses resistance profiles and mentions previous genotyping of kdr mutations, it does not report any new genotype data for the study population.
